mappedContracts.statement: Every reversible or partially reversible mutation produces a compensating plan and recovery instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Partial media upload, settings update, schedule, unschedule, revision, team, subscriber, and billing operations identify available compensation.
Irreversible operations are explicitly labelled and require stronger approval.

mappedContracts.statement: Treat media staging and draft mutation as one recoverable transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate magic bytes, size, dimensions, type, and workspace before upload.
Required media failure blocks the draft unless an explicitly approved degraded plan exists.
Orphaned uploads and partial failures produce recovery receipts.

mappedContracts.statement: Publication settings updates require an approved plan and transmit only a strict allowlisted patch with before-state evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Default library calls do not mutate.
Server-managed fields are never echoed back in a merged object.

mappedContracts.statement: Use server publication IDs, stable content IDs, repository-relative paths, preserved import provenance, and efficient event hashing.
acceptanceCriteria: Absolute local paths are not exported by default.
Imports preserve immutable event IDs, timestamps, and sequences.
Cross-platform relocation and case-folding tests pass.

mappedContracts.statement: Rate-limit policy imports may only move toward greater safety by default and cannot self-assert server provenance or confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Imported receipts cannot shorten intervals or increase mutation retries without independently approved override.
One parser handles all Retry-After forms using an injectable clock and RNG.
